title: eGovernment Benchmark 2026
description: In the context of the Digital Decade Policy Programme (DDPP), the eGovernment Benchmark study gathers all relevant indicators for the annual monitoring of online public services associated with key life events accessible to businesses and citizens within all EU member states. This study is integral to the annual assessment of eGovernment advancements, serving as a critical source for tracking the achievement of DDPP’s general objectives related to eGovernment services. More specifically, the eGovernment benchmark study allows to monitor two of the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of the DDPP: the online provision of key public services to citizens and the online provision of key public services to businesses, as defined by the Implementing Decision that establishes key performance indicators to measure progress towards digital targets. This study will support the monitoring of the public sector digitalisation by executing the next comprehensive data collection, which shall ensure continuity and comparability with respect of the indicators with the ones published in the 2024 eGovernment Benchmark Report. The data and analysis shall be ready for the publication of the 2026 State of the Digital Decade Report, to be published by mid-2026. Moreover, it will provide a comprehensive assessment of the evolution of eGovernment services across all EU countries.

description: Se doreste achizitionarea de SERVICII VOCE IN SISTEM SATELITAR cu respectarea cerintelor mentionate de autoritatea contractanta in caietul de sarcini atasat prezentului anunt. Conditii de plata: autoritatea contractanta executa obligatia de plata a sumelor de bani cu OP in 30 zile de la primirea facturii . Conditii de facturare: In formularul atasat prezentului anunt, punctul 5.7, o sa regasiti un tabel pe care trebuie sa il utilizati ca anexa la oferta financiara. Acel tabel include o oferta pentru 1 luna si o oferta pentru 12 luni. Avand in vedere ca in cursul lunii decembrie nu este inca stabilit bugetul pentru anul 2024, autoritatea contractanta o sa faca o comanda de servicii de voce in sistem satelitar mai intai pentru o luna (ianuarie 2024) urmand ca ulterior primirii bugetului sa se transmita o noua comanda pentru urmatoarele luni. Valoarea comenzilor ulterioare lunii ianuarie 2024 se va face in functie de oferta financiara pentru o luna propusa si asumata de ofertantul declarat castigator. Din acest motiv, valoarea ofertei financiare asumata ca urmare a prezentului anunt nu se poate modifica in cursul anului 2024. Operatorul economic ofertant sa posede un certificat digital care sa ateste inregistrarea in Sistemul Electronic de Achizitii Publice (SEAP). Valabilitatea ofertelor minim 60 zile de la termenul limita de primire a ofertelor. Oferta se va face la pretul unitar si se va inmulti cu cantitatea solicitata. Nu vor fi luate în considerare ofertele transmise după termenul limită sau la altă adresă ori număr de fax. La solicitarea autorității contractante, oferta clasată pe primul loc, va fi postată de ofertant în Catalogul Electronic din SEAP, în vederea finalizării online a achiziției directe. PRETUL CEL MAI SCAZUT Pentru efectuarea achizitiei este necesara postarea ofertei si in Catalogul de produse din SEAP accesibil pe internet la adresa www.e-licitatie.ro. Ofertele se vor transmite prin EMAIL : achizitii.itpfsighet@igpf.ro sau fax 0262-348.371. title: FLEX_ITT15_FLEX PLM/FIPS GPP
description:
The FLuORescence Imaging Spectrometer (FLORIS) is the Instrument of the FLuorescence Explorer Mission (FLEX) of Earth Explorer 8 (EE8) mission, 4th ?Fast-Track? 
(formerly known as Opportunity) Mission of European Space Agency.
The FLEX (Fluorescence Explorer) mission objective is to perform quantitative measurements of the solar induced vegetation fluorescence in order to 
monitor vegetation photosynthetic activity.
The FLEX Space Segment consists of a single satellite carrying the FLuORescence Imaging Spectrometer (FLORIS) push-broom instrument. This high-resolution imaging 
spectrometer will acquire data in the 500? 780 nm spectral range, with a 
sampling of 0.1 nm in the oxygen bands (759?769 nm and 686?697 nm) and 0.5?2.0 nm in the red edge, chlorophyll absorption and Photochemical Reflectance Index bands. 
The FLEX mission will work in combination with Sentinel-3's Ocean and Land Colour Instrument (OLCI) and Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer (SLSTR) 
that will provide additional information about vegetation status (TOA reflectance and temperature) and accurate atmospheric correction, which are essential 
for quantitative interpretation of fluorescence signal.
Leonardo S. p. A. is the Instrument Prime of the FLORIS Instrument contract placed by ESA. The FLEX Satellite Prime will be selected in a second procurement step. 
At FLEX Prime Satellite contract award, the FLORIS Instrument Contract will be novated under the full responsibility of the FLEX Satellite Prime.
In this framework, Leonardo S.p.A. will release an Invitation to Tender (ITT) so as to select a supplier for the activities relevant to Flex Instrument Performance 
Simulator (FIPS) and Ground Processor Prototype (GPP).
The FIPS and GPP are software tools that will evolve and serve multiple purposes since they will be used:
to support the development and verification of the Space Segment 
to support development of the Ground Segment

title: Netherlands – Gully cleaning services – Reinigen Kolken en lijngoten gemeente Zeewolde
description: De opdracht betreft het jaarlijks reinigen van straat- en trottoirkolken (incl. lijngoten) binnen het beheergebied van de gemeente Zeewolde. De gemeente Zeewolde heeft deze uitvoerende taak uitbesteed aan Waterschap Zuiderzeeland. Waterschap Zuiderzeeland treedt in deze aanbesteding op als opdrachtgever en aanbestedende dienst. Alle communicatie verloopt via Waterschap Zuiderzeeland. De omvang van de Opdracht wordt in deze Aanbestedingsleidraad uitsluitend uitgedrukt in aantallen te reinigen objecten en niet in euro’s. De geraamde jaarlijkse basisomvang bedraagt circa 11.000 straat- en trottoirkolken, inclusief circa 2.400 m1 lijngoten, binnen de gemeente Zeewolde. Uitgaande van een maximale looptijd van acht (8) jaar bedraagt de geraamde basisomvang circa 88.000 kolken. Daarnaast kan Opdrachtgever optioneel een tweede, kleinere reinigingsronde laten uitvoeren van circa 5.000 kolken per jaar. Indien deze optie gedurende de volledige maximale looptijd wordt ingezet, bedraagt de totale potentiële omvang maximaal circa 128.000 kolken. De genoemde aantallen zijn ramingen en vormen geen afnamegarantie. De feitelijke omvang kan gedurende de looptijd wijzigen door areaalmutaties, technische ontwikkelingen, beleidskeuzes of wijzigingen in de onderhoudsbehoefte. Aan de genoemde aantallen kan geen geraamde opdrachtwaarde, budget of omzetverwachting worden ontleend.
